name: Theo "Slide" Washington
fightingStyle: Long-range spacer. The slide shoots out for long pokes and sweeps, so he controls distance better than anyone. His glissando special slides him across the screen in one fast rush.
personality: Laid-back and funny, the class clown of the low brass. Hard to rattle, and smarter than he lets on.
whyTheyFight: Theo is tired of trumpets acting like they own the brass section. He also heard the winner gets to pick the post-game playlist at the fast food place, and he has opinions.
taunt: Mind the slide. Actually, don't. It's funnier.
ending: Theo wins, picks the post-game playlist, and turns the fast food restaurant into a dance party until closing time. The manager makes him promise never to slide-trombone near the milkshake machine again.
